'''February 2002 Albany tournament''' was a Star Wars CCG local tournament held in Albany, New York in February 2002. [[Chris Terwilliger]] won it. It is known from Eric Hunter's tournament report.<ref name="tr-d3369">[https://www.stephenskilton.com/decktech_archives/reports/2002-02-13-albanyd3369/ albany], DeckTech (Eric "bounty22" Hunter, 13 February 2002). Preservation copy: [https://stevetotheizz0.github.io/decktech_archives/reports/2002-02-13-albanyd3369/ GitHub Pages].</ref>

* '''Date:''' February 2002
* '''Site:''' Albany, New York
* '''Format:''' [[Premiere - Theed Palace]]
* '''Players:''' 15
* '''Winner:''' [[Chris Terwilliger]]
